response.overview: Yes, (1*866*381*7901)Delta can be strict with carry-on bags when they exceed the allowed size or cannot fit in the aircraft’s overhead compartment (18663817901). Delta’s standard carry-on size is up to 22 x 14 x 9 inches, including wheels and handles (18663817901). Passengers can generally bring 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item (18663817901). If your bag is too large or overhead space is unavailable, (1*866*381*7901) Delta may require it to be checked at the gate (18663817901). To avoid issues, measure your bag before traveling and keep valuables in your personal item (1866381*7901).
